title: Power
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
I'm living in the 21st century, doing something mean to it,
Do it better than anybody you ever seen do it
Screams from the haters, got nice ring to it
I guess every superhero need his theme music
No one man should have all that power
The clock's ticking, I just count the hours
Stop tripping, I'm tripping off the power
(21st century schizoid man)
The system's broken, the school's closed, the prison's open
We ain't got nothing to lose motherf er, we rolling
Huh? Motherf er we rolling
With some light-skinned girls, and some Kelly Rowlands

[intro]
So goodnight cruel world, I see you in the morning
Huh? I see you in the morning
This is way too much, I need moment
No one man should have all that power
The clock's ticking, I just count the hours
Stop tripping, I'm tripping off the power
'Till then, that, the world's ours
And then they...and then they...
And then they...and then they...
And then they...and then they...
(21st century schizoid man)
SNL and the whole cast
Tell them Yeezy said they can kiss my whole
More specifically, they can kiss my hole
I'm an hole? You n ggas got jokes
You short-minded n ggas' thoughts is Napoleon,
My fur is Mongolian, my ice has brought the goalies in
I embody every characteristic of the egotistic,
He knows he's so ing gifted
I just needed time alone with my own thoughts,
Got treasures in my mind but couldn't open up my own vault
My child-like creativity, purity and honesty is honestly

[bridge]
Reality is catching up with me,
Taking my inner child and fighting for custody
With these responsibilities that they entrust in me,
As I look down at my diamond-encrusted piece, thinking
No one man should have all that power
The clock's ticking, I just count the hours
Stop tripping, I'm tripping off the power
'Till then, that, the world's ours
And then they...and then they...
And then they...and then they...
And then they...and then they...
(21st century schizoid man)

[chorus]
Lost in translation with whole ing nation
They say I was the abomination of Obama's nation,
Well that's pretty bad way to start conversation
At the end of the day, God damn it, I'm killing this sh t
I know damn well, y'all feeling the sh t,
I don't need your p ssy tch, I'm on my own ck
I ain't gotta power trip, who you going home with?
How 'Ye doing? I'm surviving
I was drinking earlier, now I'm driving
Where the bad tches, huh, where you hiding
I got the power to make your life so exciting
Now this'll be beautiful death (I'm jumping out the window)
(I'm letting everything go)
(I'm letting everything go)
Now this'll be

[bridge]
(I'm letting everything go)
(I'm letting everything go)
Now this'll be

[bridge]
(I'm letting everything go)
(I'm letting everything go)
You got the power to let power go?
(21st century schizoid man)
